lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At 11:52, the whole city went dark.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And something in the dark took a step.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the floodlights hit it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It froze. Mid-step. Like a statue.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One rule. It only moves in the dark.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mia had been scared of the dark her whole life.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tonight, she had a point.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Generator's dying! Two minutes, tops!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every time the floodlights flickered…

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: …it got closer.

lines.speaker: mia
lines.text: Keep the light on its face!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then Mia saw its shadow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Behind its back, where the light couldn't reach…

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: its hand was moving.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: It's moving in its own shadow!

lines.speaker: mia
lines.text: Then light it from everywhere! Every car — circle it!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No front. No back. No shadows.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the generator died.

lines.speaker: mia
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Okay.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So Mia did what she'd done every night of her life.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She turned on her flashlight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One tiny light. Right in its eye.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: All units! Lights! Now!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Forty headlights. Zero shadows.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It never moved again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They built a park around it. The lights there never go out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And for the first time in her life…

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mia sleeps with the lights off.
